field.label: Enable anonymized routing
field.help: Overrides the server list, the relay list and the DNSCrypt/DoH/ODoH protocol settings on the Configuration page: only the resolvers below are used, each through its own relays. Unticked, dnscrypt-proxy.toml is generated exactly as without this plugin (stock, or the manual 90-eu override if its mapping is active).

field.label: Load balancing
field.help: lb_strategy · how dnscrypt-proxy picks one of the enabled resolvers for each query.

field.label: Skip incompatible routes
field.help: skip_incompatible · turning it off allows direct queries

field.label: Direct certificate fallback
field.help: direct_cert_fallback · Certificate fetch only, never user queries

field.label: ECS subnet hint
field.help: edns_client_subnet · Off by default. When ticked, the subnet below is sent to the resolvers as a location hint.

field.label: ECS subnet
field.help: Any subnet is allowed. The preset 146.70.82.0/24 is synthetic; never use your WAN subnet, it may reveal your real network.
